stories.summary: An AI-generated version of Greta Garbo has appeared in a ball-bearing advertisement, placing the silent-era and early-talkie star in a new commercial role decades after her death. Her relatives say they are willing to consider using the digital likeness in more glamorous 21st-century film roles.

stories.title: Trump Says Colombia Will Accept Deportees, Ending Tariff Standoff
stories.summary: President Trump said Colombia would accept deportees, ending a standoff in which he had threatened 25% tariffs over deportation flights. The dispute came as Trump made immigration an early priority of his second term and ICE recorded more than 900 arrests on Sunday.
